question: For how long does the non-compete restriction on a shareholder-employee last after they stop holding shares?
ground_truth_answer: The non-compete applies while the Shareholder holds shares and continues for twelve (12) months after the Shareholder ceases to hold shares.

expected_citations.span_hint: A Shareholder who is also an employee of the Company shall not engage in a competing robotics business while holding shares and for twelve (12) months after ceasing to hold shares.
